tests.name: testPhoneEEGAnimationAndGameRestore
scope: native process restart and history restoration

notes: An earlier legacy-course regression assumed the saved course stage was S1 and failed; the test now explicitly selects S1. The delivery run passed both selected tests.
The game screenshot is from the initial passing native run; game and shared assets did not change afterward. The animation screenshot is from the final boundary test.
All media dependencies are bundled. Browser QA checked offline interactions after loading; native airplane mode was not exercised.
Browser QA covers pointer dragging; native QA covers tap adjustments. Real hardware and full VoiceOver flows are not covered.
